National Cemetery Administration - Memorial Day Rentals for Ceremony - National Memorial Cemetery of AZ -- W071
This is a requirement for Memorial Day rentals at the National Memorial Cemetery of AZ. Items needed include tents, chairs, audio (PA) system, and portable toilets. Set up and tear down is needed.
